answer: External X1 binary verdict diagnostic with the preregistered native metrics.

decision.rationale: supported: CI lower bound above -0.05 and Jev AUROC CI lower bound above 0.5; not-supported: CI upper bound below -0.05; mixed otherwise. External validity check only; tau and temperature come from selection-freeze.json and are never fitted on X1; no latency claim. outcome=diagnostic-only.

limitations: External correctness analysis only; no latency or general benchmark claim.
T and tau are read from the frozen selection artifact, never refitted.
Descriptive auxiliary metrics do not add hypothesis tests.
